text.tspan: ACK boundary. Everything below runs in the processing worker, never in the HTTP request
CLAIMED (RECEIVED) or RECOVERED (PROCESSING, lease expired in DB time, attempts left) - epoch+1, attempts+1, new epoch and encrypted input to this winner only
[EXHAUSTED - lease expired and attempts used up]
NOT_AVAILABLE returns nothing. A displaced holder fails the epoch fence in its own transaction and writes nothing
[only if FS-01 verifies a provider decline control]
T2 continues only if the reservation is RESERVED or BOUND, else rollback and a NEW T1 admission
Releases only terminal, abandoned or refused setups, or owed setups past the grace, never a live session - fence makes T2 and T4 strictly ordered
Voice outbox rows stay PENDING - LS-D-VOX owes 6 groups and is CLOSED in every environment
[each turn - no REST, no event bus, no synchronous Billing/CRM/Analytics write]
Missing or corrupt service-end or checkpoint - CORRUPT_STATE + RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, no EV-079, never an estimate

svg.text: dials business number
provider event + signature
size and rate guards, keep raw bytes, verify signature over raw bytes
reject - ZERO rows written (CBK-01)
resolve_inbound_phone_number(to) - tenant from platform state, never from payload
provider_event_id, allocate receipt id R, extract closed versioned input (CPU only)
TX-7 receipt R only, status FAILED + category - no input, no KMS call (CBK-17)
2xx - durably recorded, nothing owed
generate wrapped data key, encrypt input, AAD = purpose, org, R, schema (no transaction open) [BLOCKED OD-W0-13]
TX-7 insert receipt R ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, input keyed by R only if R was inserted [BLOCKED OD-W0-12]
5xx - nothing stored (CBI-05)
2xx identical for both - durably received, not processed
cross-tenant discovery - returns ONLY receipt_id and organization_id
one transaction under that tenant - claim-or-recover(receipt_id) locks the receipt and decides internally
same transaction - receipt FAILED, epoch+1 fences the last holder, input kept up to 7 days, no business effect
same transaction - identity whose origin receipt is this one PENDING to ABANDONED, a BOUND or CLOSED identity is untouched
decrypt outside any transaction (decrypt-only workload)
T0 identity claim UNIQUE(org, provider, call ref) - one call_session_id, terminal identity = no admission [BLOCKED W0-MR-02]
T1 AcquireCapacity - setup fence, pool lock, count RESERVED+BOUND, (occupied+1) <= hard_limit [BLOCKED W0-MR-01]
refused - nothing written
T3 one transaction - receipt epoch fence, identity PENDING to REFUSED, receipt PROCESSED, input deleted
separate TelephonyPort control call (reject or hang up) - otherwise the media stream is not accepted
fail closed - receipt left to the sweep, bounded attempts, then ABANDONED + FAILED
T2 ONE transaction - receipt epoch fence (epoch = mine), identity lock, setup fence, revalidate reservation via Billing guarded read
T2 - call_sessions row + if answered conversation + conversation_id + EV-073 + EV-074
T2 - identity BOUND, receipt PROCESSED, input deleted - then COMMIT (all or nothing)
T4 reconciler - setup fence, pool, reservation, then read Voice setup state
WS connect + start frame
bind to the admitted session (bounded wait if the socket arrives before T2 commits)
caller audio frames
decoded PCM16 chunks
VAD endpoint committed - 6D metric START and L-1 START (gateway clock)
streaming STT final
LLM stream (prompt version + history)
TTS stream from first sentence fragment
synthesized audio
first audible egress frame - L-1 END (gateway clock)
audio heard - 6D metric END (caller clock - L-4 only via calibrated sync, else NOT MEASURED)
cancel TTS and LLM, drop queued audio (6D §14, DEP-6D-08)
per-turn checkpoint, checkpoint_at = GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), previous) [BLOCKED G-02]
final transcript segment (finals only)
hang-up event (same verified, durable ingress path)
one transaction - receipt epoch fence, terminal state + persisted service-end + EV-005 or EV-006 + identity CLOSED + receipt PROCESSED + input deleted
T5 ReleaseCapacity(call_session_id) - fence, idempotent, reconciler releases if this is lost
abnormal end only - reaper forces terminal state, service-end = last committed checkpoint_at
shared finalization under the accounting row lock - guard, EV-079 once, occurred_at = persisted service-end [BLOCKED G-02]
GET /api/v1/calls, /calls/{id} under tenant RLS - transcript content needs transcript:access_content
